name: Zhipu BigModel
description: Zhipu's mainland-China platform, which marks its Flash models as free with no token charge.
overview: BigModel is Zhipu's mainland-China platform, separate from Z.AI international. Its model overview marks a set of Flash models as free, including GLM-4.7-Flash with a 200K context, plus free image and video Flash models. Free Flash models run with low concurrency.
free_access: Flash models marked free with no token charge
notes: Phone verification required; GLM-4.7-Flash is reported at one concurrent request.
